record.question: Which country awards the Nobel Prize?
record.explanation: Answer D: Sweden. Sweden is the matching listed country: physics, chemistry, physiology/medicine and literature Nobels are presented in Stockholm, as is the economic-sciences memorial prize. The Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo, Norway, which is absent from the options. Historical/source note: Most Nobel categories are awarded in Sweden; the Nobel Peace Prize is awarded in Norway. The question must not be explained as saying all Nobels are awarded in Sweden. Reference: https://www.nobelprize.org/ceremony/the-nobel-prize-award-ceremonies-and-banquets/?print=1. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
